# themontana – Remzi AKIN

> Independent mobile apps and games by Remzi AKIN (themontana), Samsun, Türkiye. Main product: LGS İngilizce Kelime, a free Turkish app that helps 8th-grade students prepare for the English section of the LGS high-school entrance exam.

## LGS İngilizce Kelime

- Who it is for: 8th-grade students in Türkiye preparing for LGS English (the 10 English questions in the exam's verbal section in recent years), plus their parents and English teachers.
- What it contains: 1152 words and phrases from the 10 units of the 8th-grade English curriculum (Friendship, Teen Life, In the Kitchen, On the Phone, The Internet, Adventures, Tourism, Chores, Science, Natural Forces); an example sentence for every word; 151 explained LGS-style context questions (dialogue, paragraph, chart/table, recipe, invitation); a 10-question timed mock exam; spaced-repetition review; flashcards, listening, matching and letter games; question stems and commonly confused words; a personal word list and offline dictionary.
- Price and access: free on Android and iOS. No account needed; learning records stay on the device and the app works offline. Optional rewarded ads (non-personalized, child-directed, never required for lessons) and anonymous usage analytics are on by default and can be turned off in Settings.
- Language: Turkish interface, English learning content.
- Not affiliated with MEB (Turkish Ministry of National Education); the content follows the published 8th-grade curriculum.

## Free LGS English resources (Turkish)

- [8. sınıf İngilizce kelimeleri – all 10 units](https://themontana.github.io/lgs-kelimeleri/): printable word lists with Turkish meanings, example sentences and sample questions.
- [LGS İngilizce nasıl çalışılır?](https://themontana.github.io/lgs-kelimeleri/lgs-ingilizce-nasil-calisilir/): question types, question stems (NOT, EXCEPT, According to…), commonly confused words and a 10-week vocabulary plan.
- [Unit 1 Friendship](https://themontana.github.io/lgs-kelimeleri/unite-1-friendship/)

- [Unit 6 Adventures](https://themontana.github.io/lgs-kelimeleri/unite-6-adventures/)
